title: Segment Entries in the Virtual Word
statement: Let a finite list of segments be given, and let $i$ be a valid segment index. If $k$ is smaller than the rendered length of the segment at index $i$, then the possibly undefined entry at index $\operatorname{off}(i)+k$ in the virtual word formed by rendering the segments with separators equals the entry at index $k$ in the rendering of segment $i$.
hypotheses_covered: The segment index $i$ is less than the number of segments.
$k$ is less than the rendered length of the segment at index $i$.
